evaluation.binding_each_pool: answer >=76/80; BOTH_DISTINCT >=76/80; slot collapse = 0 independently on both pools
evaluation.checkpoint_selection: earliest among updates 100, 250, 500 that passes all frozen machine readiness and binding gates; final readiness eligibility additionally requires the frozen blinded review. No post-hoc selection.
evaluation.human_review_gates: two blinded reviewers must independently mark at least 14/20 complete, 14/20 relevant, and 12/20 both complete and relevant; disagreement fails the affected item. Raw outputs are retained; human review is required before a HUMAN_TEST_READY claim.
evaluation.readiness_dev: frozen prospective v2 only; FINAL is sealed and never opened

hypothesis: Allowing exactly transformer block 3 to adapt during English updates may improve contextual-language acquisition relative to the corrected aligned HR-1 protected scope, while binding rehearsal protects established T13 behavior.

mechanical_completion.correction: restore_rng passes [value.cpu() for value in torch_rng_cuda] to torch.cuda.set_rng_state_all.
mechanical_completion.reason: v5 resume moved saved CUDA RNG state through map_location=cuda; torch.cuda.set_rng_state_all requires CPU ByteTensor values on the pinned runtime.

parent_rationale: Pilot 1 is the only defensible language parent: it has direct language-acquisition evidence and passed both nonsacred binding pools. The aligned HR-1 descendant is an evaluation baseline, not a parent, because it did not meet contextual behavior criteria.
scientific_delta_from_corrected_aligned_: English updates newly train block 3. Blocks 0-2 remain frozen; all other data, objective, schedule, optimizer, cadence, runtime, binding rehearsal, and gates are byte-for-byte inherited.

stopping.if_no_checkpoint_passes: preserve and classify as failed bounded scope treatment; diagnose before another treatment

training.binding_scope: full established T13 trainable scope restored every tenth update
training.cadence: 50 cycles of nine literal English updates followed by one literal binding update
training.english_scope: train token embeddings, positional embeddings, transformer blocks 3-7, final normalization, language head; freeze transformer blocks 0-2 and specialized localizer/retrieval parameters

objective.binding: exact pinned Pilot-1 answer causal CE + LAM 1.0536573711078283 times hard-min permutation-invariant localization loss
objective.english: z=[BOS=2]+content+[EOS=3]; x=z[:-1], y=z[1:] at the same positions; mean full-vocabulary CE over every content target and final EOS, padded labels=-100

optimizer.state: one fresh optimizer persists continuously across all 500 updates

runtime.python_bytecode: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 and python -B are required for all frozen-bundle execution, validation, training, and evaluation commands
